C0498-S0087.quote: In no event shall either party be responsible for any special, punitive, or consequential damages whatsoever.
C0498-S0087.explanation: This clause excludes special, punitive, and consequential damages, satisfying the limitation of liability rule.

C0498-S0108.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE ABOVE AND REGARDLESS OF THE CIRCUMSTANCES, SELLER'S TOTAL LIABILITY TO BUYER FOR ANY AND ALL CLAIMS, LOSSES OR DAMAGES ARISING OUT OF ANY CAUSE WHATSOEVER, WHETHER BASED IN CONTRACT, NEGLIGENCE OR OTHER TORT, STRICT LIABILITY, BREACH OF WARRANTY OR OTHERWISE, SHALL IN NO EVENT EXCEED THE PURCHASE PRICE OF PRODUCT IN RESPECT TO WHICH SUCH CAUSE AROSE.
C0498-S0108.explanation: This clause explicitly caps the seller's total liability at the purchase price of the product.

C0498-S0119.quote: The parties' rights and obligations hereunder shall be construed and enforced under the laws of the State of Texas, U.S.A., without regard to conflict of laws principles.
C0498-S0119.explanation: This clause expressly states that the contract is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

C0498-S0123.quote: This Agreement shall not be assigned in whole or in part by Buyer or Seller without the written consent of the other party and any attempted assignment without such consent shall be void and of no effect, except that Seller may assign all of its rights and obligations hereunder to any entity of which Exxon Mobil Corporation owns, directly or indirectly, at least fifty percent (50%) of the shares or other indicia of equity having the right to elect such entity's board of directors or other governing body.
C0498-S0123.explanation: This clause restricts assignment without consent while allowing certain corporate affiliate transfers.

C0498-S0168.quote: Buyer/Buyer Affiliates agrees to pay for all repairs for damage to any Metal Crate, or to pay the replacement charge of $[*****] per Metal Crate for any Metal Crate that is either permanently lost or damaged beyond repair while in the custody of Buyer/Buyer Affiliates
C0498-S0168.explanation: This clause fixes a predetermined replacement and repair charge payable upon loss or damage of property.

C0498-S0175.quote: Seller shall have the right at all times to appoint an independent surveyor.
C0498-S0175.explanation: This clause gives a party the right to appoint an independent surveyor to inspect and assess shipments.

C0498-S0182.quote: Seller's total liability for all claims arising hereunder or connected with the products sold hereunder, whether based in contract, tort or otherwise, shall be no greater than an amount equal to the purchase price of the products to which any such claims relate
C0498-S0182.explanation: This clause places a monetary cap on the seller's total liability.

C0498-S0189.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by Singapore law, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
C0498-S0189.explanation: This clause explicitly states that Singapore law governs the contract, satisfying the governing law requirement.

C0498-S0190.quote: This Agreement shall not be assigned, in whole or in part, by either party without the prior consent of the other party
C0498-S0190.explanation: This provision restricts the assignment of the contract by requiring prior consent from the other party.

C0498-S0217.quote: EM's maximum liability for all claims for any reason is the sales price of the product involved and EM shall not be liable for indirect or consequential damage.
C0498-S0217.explanation: This clause caps liability at the sales price and excludes indirect or consequential damages, directly satisfying R-01.

C0498-S0223.quote: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the written consent of the other party save in the case where such assignment is to an EM Affiliate
C0498-S0223.explanation: This clause restricts assignment without written consent, thus triggering review for assignment limitations.

C0498-S0227.quote: In the event that a party becomes aware that it will or may undergo a Change of Control ("Affected Party") within the following three (3) Months, the Affected Party will notify the other party without delay
C0498-S0227.explanation: This clause establishes notification requirements and consequences related to a party undergoing a change of control.

C0498-S0228.quote: then the other party may (but is not obliged to) terminate this Agreement forthwith upon notice to the Affected Party.
C0498-S0228.explanation: This text grants a party the right to terminate upon a change of control of the other party.

C0498-S0229.quote: This Agreement between EM and Buyer shall be governed by the laws of Belgium (excluding its rules on conflict of laws).
C0498-S0229.explanation: The clause names the specific jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement.
